question: What supreme seed is identified with the complete lady of worlds?
premises: The goddess is named as complete and lady of worlds.
A supreme seed of Kāmeśī is declared.
inference: The complete Bhuvaneśānī is identified with the supreme seed of Kāmeśī.
uncertainties: The exact syllabic form of the seed is not spelled out in this verse.
plain_english: The complete lady of the worlds is the supreme seed of Kāmeśī.
